rule: POST HOC follow-up to stage 1. PRIMARY = per-visit size matching (OFF decodes top-k_i with k_i = ON's predicted size at threshold 0.5). SUPPORTED iff H1 (mean dJaccard < 0, patient-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0) AND H2 (permutation p_range across 24 CC clusters < 0.05) AND H3 (Spearman rho[stage-0 GT DDI, cluster dJaccard] < 0, one-sided permutation p < 0.05), test split, seeds 0..3 averaged per visit. Global-threshold matching and test+eval are sensitivity only. Rule fixed before this analysis's results were seen.
